name: Milawa

facts.claim: Milawa is a village and the northern end of the King Valley, at 155 m altitude
It is the centre of the Milawa Gourmet Region, Australia's first official gourmet region, with Oxley, Tarrawingee, Markwood and Whorouly
Brown Brothers Cellar Door and Milawa Cheese Company are its best-known stops
Wangaratta to Milawa section of the Murray to Mountains Rail Trail is a 5 km ride

ticketUrl_note: No single steward; a village. Tourism page is the regional board (visitwangaratta.com.au), not an official site for the village

name: King Valley

facts.claim: Wine and agricultural region centred on the King River between Wangaratta and the Alpine National Park
Italian migrants of the 1940s-50s moved from tobacco to wine, producing sangiovese, nebbiolo and barbera
Some of Australia's highest vineyards, about 800 m, are on the Whitlands Plateau
The former Whitfield railway line route is now a rail trail

name: Warby-Ovens National Park

facts.claim: Park about 10 km from Wangaratta protecting river red gum forest on the Ovens River, box-ironbark forest and the granite Warby Range
Ryan's Lookout and Kwat Kwat Lookout give exceptional views, with snow-covered peaks visible in winter
Spring wildflowers in the Warby Range; walking, cycling, canoeing and camping

Ticket also includes Kellyland's museum with the Railway Tavern bar, wanted posters, Ned's death mask and John Dollery paintings
